wrestlers.bio: A small-town kid who grew up glued to wrestling, I'm stepping into a league for the very first time. Bringing heavy-hitting size into the ring, he pairs his physical presence with the grind—studying film like map layouts, learning from veterans, and adjusting his loadout on the fly. Quiet, observant, and eager to prove he belongs, he stays out of the crosshairs, controls the ring, and waits for the right window to close out the match.
